description: This file contains PHP classes related to security scanning within the SuiteCRM project, including SugarSecure, ScanFileIncludes, and SugarSecureManager, with methods for scanning files, displaying results, and managing scanners.

classes.name: SugarSecure
classes.description: A class for scanning directories for PHP files, displaying results, and saving results to a file.

classes.name: ScanFileIncludes
classes.description: A subclass of SugarSecure that scans PHP file contents for include and require statements.

classes.name: SugarSecureManager
classes.description: A manager class that handles multiple scanner instances, running scans, displaying results, and saving output.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs the scan results as an HTML table.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the scan results to a specified file.

methods.name: scan
methods.description: Recursively scans directories for PHP files.

methods.name: scanContents
methods.description: Analyzes file contents for include/require statements.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves results from all scanners to a file.
